process_description: Used as nutrient-rich substrate for farming oyster mushrooms
Dried and compressed into eco-friendly heating pellets
Added to industrial compost to adjust nitrogen ratios
Combined with resin to create low-cost furniture boards
Pressed into clean-burning fuel pellets for stoves
Shredded and carded into recycled insulation and stuffing fiber
Melted and extruded into high-quality recycled plastic pellets
Crushed and melted in furnace to produce new bottles
Refined in furnace to make new steel or aluminum alloys
Processed in anaerobic digester to produce methane gas and digestate
Crushed to replace virgin gravel in road bases and concrete mixes
Hydrolyzed and fermented to produce industrial-grade bioethanol
